title: Bustle Of Life
author: Bandana Sahoo
text:
In the hustle and bustle of life
It makes me a non-believer,
When to laugh;
When will I cry again?
He is far from an atmosphere of peace,
Every day, he calls out to me, waving his hand.

Feeling very restless in the hustle and bustle
This is my life;
With breathless eyes
I am waiting for him.
Far away........!!!!
Those proud eyes of his,
His two hands
The wind calls me in its passion,
In the touch of that evening`s coolness
To hold in your arms.

Do you know my helplessness?
That intimacy of seeing you every day,
Sometimes in the darkness of the evening twilight
And when in that gentle morning air.

Wow...!!
I am searching for the scent of experience.
Peace is at your feet,
With your touch,
That loose white hair of yours.
With a light smile,
And that wet sand
On the gray beach.

I will refresh myself once again.
The darkness is lost in the scattered leaves,
You will see countless dreams in these eyes,
In that gray sand
Thousands of footprints making themselves felt.

The feeling of lies is lost in the rise.
Joining hands with yours,
Dreams in the eyes are like flowers;
To the feet that are still on the thorny path
Covered in blood
Being an unadorned,
With selfless feelings
Draw has many colorful pictures,
To be lifted by the wet tide of love
With you,
That same fly is a false sandbar.
